description: This Java class `ProducerClosedStatusReport` represents a report indicating that a JMS `MessageProducer` has been closed. It encapsulates a reference to the `MessageProducer` and provides static factory method for instantiation and a getter method.
external_methods: javax.jms.MessageProducer (interface methods, e.g., close, send, etc.)

classes.name: ProducerClosedStatusReport
classes.description: Represents a status report indicating that a JMS MessageProducer has been closed, encapsulating the producer instance.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new instance of ProducerClosedStatusReport with the given MessageProducer.

methods.name: getMessageProducer
methods.description: Returns the MessageProducer associated with this report.
